title: 236. Lemonade Change

examples.explanation: From the first 3 customers, we collect three $5 bills. From the fourth, we collect a $10 and give back a $5. From the fifth, we give a $10 and a $5.
From the first two customers we collect two $5. From the third and fourth we collect two $10 and give back two $5. For the fifth we cannot give $15 change.

hints: Track counts of $5 and $10 bills. Prefer giving a $10+$5 when possible for a $20.
